sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM CUSTOMER;
SELECT Name FROM GENRE ORDER BY Name;
SELECT MAX(UnitPrice) FROM TRACK;
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM CUSTOMER WHERE Country = 'Brazil';
SELECT FirstName, LastName FROM EMPLOYEE WHERE Title = 'Sales Support Agent';
SELECT SUM(T2.Total) FROM INVOICE AS T1 JOIN INVOICELINE AS T2 ON T1.InvoiceId = T2.InvoiceId;
SELECT Title FROM ALBUM WHERE Title ILIKE '%Greatest%';
SELECT AVG(Milliseconds) FROM TRACK;
SELECT Name FROM TRACK WHERE Milliseconds > 2000;
SELECT T2.Name, COUNT(*) FROM GENRE AS T1 JOIN TRACK AS T2 ON T1.GenreID = T2.GenreID GROUP BY T1.GenreID, T2.Name;
SELECT T2.Name FROM ALBUM AS T1 JOIN ARTIST AS T2 ON T1.ArtistId = T2.ArtistId GROUP BY T1.ArtistId, T2.Name ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1;

SELECT T1.FirstName, T1.LastName, SUM(T2.Total) FROM CUSTOMER AS T1 JOIN INVOICE AS T2 ON T1.CustomerId = T2.CustomerId GROUP BY T1.CustomerId, T1.FirstName, T1.LastName ORDER BY SUM(T2.Total) DESC LIMIT 3;
SELECT BillingCountry, SUM(T1.UnitPrice) FROM INVOICE AS T1 JOIN CUSTOMER AS T2 ON T1.CustomerId = T2.CustomerId GROUP BY BillingCountry ORDER BY SUM(T1.UnitPrice) DESC LIMIT 5;
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM INVOICE WHERE INVOICEDATE ILIKE '%2023%';
SELECT SUM(T2.UnitPrice), T1.Year FROM INVOICE AS T1 JOIN INVOICELINE AS T2 ON T1.InvoiceId = T2.InvoiceId GROUP BY T1.Year ORDER BY T1.Year;
SELECT Title FROM ALBUM AS T1 JOIN TRACK AS T2 ON T1.AlbumId = T2.AlbumId WHERE T1.ArtistId = (SELECT ArtistId FROM ARTIST WHERE Name = 'AC/DC');
SELECT T2.Name FROM ALBUM AS T1 JOIN TRACK AS T2 ON T1.AlbumId = T2.AlbumId WHERE T1.Title = 'Let There Be Rock';
SELECT T2.Name, COUNT(*) FROM INVOICELINE AS T1 JOIN TRACK AS T2 ON T1.TrackId = T2.TrackId GROUP BY T2.MediaTypeId, T2.Name;
SELECT AVG(T2.Total), T1.BillingCountry FROM INVOICE AS T1 JOIN INVOICELINE AS T2 ON T1.InvoiceId = T2.InvoiceId GROUP BY T1.BillingCountry;
SELECT T1.FirstName, T1.LastName FROM EMPLOYEE AS T1 JOIN EMPLOYEE AS T2 ON T1.EmployeeID = T2.ReportsTo WHERE T1.FirstName = 'Nancy' AND T1.LastName = 'Edwards';
SELECT FirstName, LastName, COUNT(*) FROM CUSTOMER AS T1 JOIN EMPLOYEE AS T2 ON T1.SupportRepId = T2.EmployeeId GROUP BY T1.SupportRepId, T2.FirstName, T2.LastName;
SELECT PlaylistId, Name FROM Playlist WHERE PlaylistId IN (SELECT PlaylistId FROM PlaylistTrack GROUP BY PlaylistId HAVING COUNT(*) > 1000);
SELECT T2.Name, AVG(T1.UnitPrice) FROM INVOICELINE AS T1 JOIN TRACK AS T2 ON T1.TrackId = T2.TrackId GROUP BY T2.GenreId, T2.Name;
SELECT Composer FROM TRACK GROUP BY Composer HAVING COUNT(*) > 20;

SELECT T2.Name, SUM(T1.UnitPrice * T1.Quantity) FROM INVOICE AS T1 JOIN GENRE AS T2 ON T1.GenreId = T2.GenreId WHERE T1.InvoiceDate > '2016-01-01' GROUP BY T1.GenreId, T2.Name ORDER BY SUM(T1.UnitPrice * T1.Quantity) DESC LIMIT 1;
SELECT T1.Name, COUNT(*) FROM ARTIST AS T1 JOIN TRACK AS T2 ON T1.ArtistID = T2.GenreID GROUP BY T1.ArtistID, T1.Name ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 3;
SELECT T1.FirstName, T1.LastName FROM CUSTOMER AS T1 JOIN INVOICE AS T2 ON T1.CustomerId = T2.CustomerId JOIN TRACK AS T3 ON T3.TrackId = T2.TrackId WHERE T3.GenreID = 1;

SELECT T1.FirstName, T1.LastName, SUM(T2.revenue) FROM CUSTOMER AS T1 JOIN INVOICE AS T2 ON T1.customerid = T2.customerid JOIN EMPLOYEE AS T3 ON T1.supportrepid = T3.employeeid GROUP BY T1.FirstName, T1.LastName;
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TRACK WHERE TrackId NOT IN (SELECT TrackId FROM INVOICE);
SELECT T1.Title, T1.Milliseconds FROM ALBUM AS T1 JOIN TRACK AS T2 ON T1.AlbumId = T2.AlbumId ORDER BY T1.Milliseconds DESC LIMIT 5;
SELECT T2.Name FROM GENRE AS T1 JOIN ARTIST AS T2 ON T1.ArtistId = T2.ArtistId GROUP BY T2.Name HAVING COUNT(*) > 1;
SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN T2.Milliseconds > 5000 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(*) FROM INVOICE AS T1 JOIN TRACK AS T2 ON T1.InvoiceId = T2.TrackId;
SELECT FirstName, LastName, HireDate FROM EMPLOYEE WHERE Company = (SELECT MAX(Company) FROM EMPLOYEE);

SELECT FirstName, LastName FROM CUSTOMER WHERE CustomerId IN (SELECT CustomerId FROM INVOICE AS T1 JOIN CUSTOMER AS T2 ON T1.CustomerId = T2.CustomerId GROUP BY T1.CustomerId, T2.FirstName, T2.LastName HAVING SUM(T1.Total) > (SELECT AVG(T1.Total) FROM INVOICE AS T1 JOIN CUSTOMER AS T2 ON T1.CustomerId = T2.CustomerId));

SELECT T1.GenreID, T1.Name, SUM(T2.Quantity) FROM GENRE AS T1 JOIN INVOICELINE AS T2 ON T2.InvoiceId = T1.GenreID JOIN TRACK AS T3 ON T3.TrackId = T2.TrackId GROUP BY T1.GenreID, T1.Name ORDER BY T1.GenreID, T1.Name;
SELECT MONTH, SUM(T2.UnitPrice), T2.Month FROM INVOICE AS T1 JOIN INVOICELINE AS T2 ON T1.InvoiceId = T2.InvoiceId WHERE T1.BillingYear = 2025 GROUP BY T1.Month, T2.Month ORDER BY T1.Month;
SELECT T1.Name, CAST(SUM(T2.UnitPrice * 1.0 / T1.MediaTypeId) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(*) FROM GENRE AS T1 JOIN INVOICELINE AS T2 ON T1.GenreID = T2.GenreID WHERE T1.Name <> 'Other' GROUP BY T1.Name;
SELECT T1.FirstName, T1.LastName FROM CUSTOMER AS T1 JOIN INVOICE AS T2 ON T1.CustomerId = T2.CustomerId WHERE T2.InvoiceDate >= '2021-01-01' AND T2.InvoiceDate <= '2025-12-31';
SELECT T1.Name, AVG(T2.Milliseconds) FROM ARTIST AS T1 JOIN TRACK AS T2 ON T1.ArtistID = T2.GenreID GROUP BY T1.ArtistID, T1.Name HAVING COUNT(*) >= 10;
SELECT T1.FirstName, T1.LastName, T2.FirstName, T2.LastName FROM EMPLOYEE AS T1 JOIN EMPLOYEE AS T2 ON T1.ReportsTo = T2.EmployeeId;

SELECT MONTH, SUM(T1.UnitPrice) FROM INVOICE AS T1 JOIN CUSTOMER AS T2 ON T1.CustomerId = T2.CustomerId WHERE T1.InvoiceDate >= '2022-01-01' AND T1.InvoiceDate < '2022-12-31' GROUP BY MONTH ORDER BY MONTH;
SELECT PlaylistId FROM Playlist WHERE PlaylistId NOT IN (SELECT PlaylistId FROM PlaylistTrack);
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM countries;
SELECT name FROM countries WHERE region = 'South Asia';
SELECT capital_city FROM countries WHERE name = 'Japan';
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM countries WHERE income_group = 'Low income';
SELECT population FROM country_stats WHERE iso3 = 'India' AND YEAR = 2023;
SELECT name, population FROM countries WHERE YEAR = 2023 ORDER BY population DESC LIMIT 5;
SELECT income_group, COUNT(*) FROM countries GROUP BY income_group;
SELECT gdp_per_capita_usd FROM country_stats WHERE YEAR = 2023 ORDER BY gdp_per_capita_usd DESC LIMIT 1;
SELECT SUM(population), YEAR FROM countries GROUP BY YEAR ORDER BY YEAR;
SELECT t1.name FROM countries AS t1 JOIN country_stats AS t2 ON t1.iso3 = t2.iso3 WHERE t2.life_expectancy_years > 70 AND t2.year = 2023;
SELECT unemployment_pct, YEAR FROM country_stats WHERE name = 'Germany' ORDER BY YEAR;
SELECT AVG(fertility_rate), region FROM country_stats WHERE YEAR = 2023 GROUP BY region;
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM country_stats WHERE gdp_usd > 10000000;

SELECT t1.name FROM countries AS t1 JOIN country_stats AS t2 ON t1.iso3 = t2.iso3 WHERE t1.region = 'Europe & Central Asia' AND t2.fertility_rate = (SELECT MIN(fertility_rate) FROM country_stats WHERE YEAR = 2023);
SELECT gdp_usd, gdp_per_capita_usd FROM country_stats WHERE YEAR = 2000 OR YEAR = 2023;
SELECT t1.region FROM countries AS t1 JOIN country_stats AS t2 ON t1.iso3 = t2.iso3 WHERE t2.internet_users_pct > 70 AND t2.year = 2023;
SELECT population - population FROM country_stats WHERE YEAR BETWEEN 2000 AND 2023;
SELECT name, (2023 - 2000) FROM country_stats WHERE life_expectancy_years BETWEEN 2000 AND 2023 ORDER BY (2023 - 2000) DESC LIMIT 5;
SELECT SUM(gdp_usd), income_group FROM country_stats WHERE YEAR = 2023 GROUP BY income_group ORDER BY SUM(gdp_usd) DESC;
SELECT name FROM countries WHERE gdp_per_capita_usd > (SELECT AVG(gdp_per_capita_usd) FROM countries WHERE region = 'GDP per capita');
SELECT AVG(life_expectancy_years) FROM country_stats WHERE YEAR = 2023;
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM country_stats WHERE population < (SELECT MIN(population) FROM country_stats WHERE YEAR = 2023);
SELECT name, region, life_expectancy_years FROM country_stats WHERE YEAR = 2023 AND life_expectancy_years < 60;
SELECT SUM(life_expectancy_years) * 100 / SUM(gdp_per_capita_usd) FROM country_stats WHERE YEAR = 2023;
SELECT name FROM countries WHERE iso3 NOT IN (SELECT iso3 FROM country_stats WHERE YEAR = 2023);
SELECT gdp_per_capita_usd, YEAR FROM country_stats WHERE name = 'France' ORDER BY YEAR;
SELECT T1.income_group, T2.name, T2.gdp_per_capita_usd FROM countries AS T1 JOIN country_stats AS T2 ON T1.iso3 = T2.iso3 WHERE T2.year = 2023 ORDER BY T2.gdp_per_capita_usd DESC;
SELECT median(your_region), urban_population_pct FROM country_stats WHERE YEAR = 2023 GROUP BY your_region;
SELECT * FROM country_stats WHERE internet_users_pct < 10 AND internet_users_pct > 50 AND YEAR = 2010;
SELECT gdp_per_capita_usd, life_expectancy_years FROM country_stats WHERE YEAR = 2023;
SELECT T1.region, T1.name, T2.population FROM countries AS T1 JOIN country_stats AS T2 ON T1.iso3 = T2.iso3 WHERE T2.year = 2023 ORDER BY T2.population DESC;
SELECT T1.region, T1.name, T2.unemployment_pct FROM countries AS T1 JOIN country_stats AS T2 ON T1.iso3 = T2.iso3 WHERE T2.year = 2020;
SELECT T1.region, T2.year, AVG(T1.lifetime_expectancy_years) FROM countries AS T1 JOIN country_stats AS T2 ON T1.iso3 = T2.iso3 GROUP BY T1.region, T2.year;
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM penguins;
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM penguins WHERE species = 'Gentoo';
SELECT DISTINCT island FROM penguins;
SELECT MAX(body_mass_g) FROM penguins;
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM penguins WHERE sex = 'unknown';
SELECT AVG(flipper_length_mm) FROM penguins;
SELECT COUNT(*), species FROM penguins GROUP BY species;
SELECT AVG(body_mass_g) FROM penguins;
SELECT COUNT(*), T2.island, T2.year FROM penguins AS T1 JOIN islands AS T2 ON T1.island = T2.name GROUP BY T2.island, T2.year;
SELECT AVG(bill_length_mm) FROM penguins WHERE sex = 'male' UNION SELECT AVG(bill_length_mm) FROM penguins WHERE sex = 'female';
SELECT species FROM penguins WHERE flipper_length_mm = (SELECT AVG(flipper_length_mm) FROM penguins);
SELECT MIN(bill_depth_mm), MAX(bill_depth_mm), species FROM penguins GROUP BY species;
SELECT island FROM penguins GROUP BY island ORDER BY COUNT(species) DESC LIMIT 1;
SELECT AVG(body_mass_g), sex FROM penguins WHERE sex <> 'unknown' GROUP BY sex, species;
SELECT species FROM penguins WHERE body_mass_g = (SELECT MAX(body_mass_g) FROM penguins WHERE sex = 'male') - (SELECT MIN(body_mass_g) FROM penguins WHERE sex = 'female');
SELECT COUNT(species) FROM penguins WHERE bill_length_mm > (SELECT AVG(bill_length_mm) FROM penguins);
SELECT COUNT(species) FROM penguins WHERE species = 'Gentoo' AND island = 'Biscoe';
SELECT COUNT(*), species, YEAR FROM penguins GROUP BY species, YEAR ORDER BY species, YEAR;
SELECT island FROM penguins GROUP BY island HAVING COUNT(species) > 1;
SELECT AVG(bill_length_mm / bill_depth_mm), species FROM penguins GROUP BY species;
SELECT species, island, body_mass_g FROM penguins ORDER BY body_mass_g DESC LIMIT 1;
SELECT species, AVG(body_mass_g), AVG(body_mass_g) FROM penguins WHERE YEAR = 2007 OR YEAR = 2009 GROUP BY species;
SELECT species, island FROM penguins GROUP BY species, island HAVING AVG(flipper_length_mm) > (SELECT AVG(flipper_length_mm) FROM penguins);
SELECT rank, species, AVG(bill_length_mm) FROM penguins GROUP BY species, rank;
SELECT ROUND(SUM(bill_mass_g), 2) / COUNT(species) FROM penguins;
